  {U : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} (hU : U ∈ Roth.RSet M fun j ↦ l * r (some j)) {V : Polynomial ℤ} (hV : V ≠ 0)
  (hVd : V.natDegree ≤ l * r none) (hVc : ∀ (b : ℕ), |↑(V.coeff b)| ≤ M) :
  Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((rename some) U * (Polynomial.aeval (X none)) V)) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤
    ↑l * Roth.lem6Φ q r M l

                        Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((rename some) U * (Polynomial.aeval (X none)) V))
                            (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤
                          ↑l * Roth.lem6Φ q r M l :=

    ⟨hV'0,

        (Eq.trans h0 (Eq.symm (map_zero (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))))));
